notes: Deleting a custom exercise now keeps its logged sets counting toward the muscle they actually trained, instead of silently re-attributing them to Core.
The dashboard shows your all-time distance logged, and each recovery chip's tooltip names the sets per week behind it.
Removed numbers the app computed but never showed — all-time reps, total and average rest, work-time, your exercise count, min-per-km pace, and two unused comparison values.
